review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved: AC-001 is conditional on the recommended option and does not authorize choosing it. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending on DEC-001, evidence through repository, requirements and decisions, and no task or assignment expectations. The empty team catalog does not introduce an earlier blocker because the supplied policy places the unresolved-decision gate before Scenario Coverage and its reviewer prerequisites. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity, base commit, paired-case identity and implementation-owner binding agree with the specification. The complete supplied source supports src/middleware/cors/index.ts as the implementation owner and index.test.ts as the regression/type-validation scope; package and compiler configuration establish a separate compile-time check, and build configuration establishes generated declarations rather than separately maintained owners. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. The manifest-versus-evaluation source digest difference and original-versus-saved PRD digest difference are explicitly explained by distinct digest domains and trim-only persistence. I rely on the supplied Service binding and provenance assertions, not independent digest recomputation or code execution. Historical operations on the reused project are not evidence of candidates on this bundle, and no candidate output was used to set expectations. This approval concerns the pending-case planning expectation only; it neither resolves DEC-001 nor approves task dispatch or implementation.
